fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable content-and-source-row identifier.

fields.name: period_key
fields.description: Catalogue period key; annual and multi-quarter periods stay unsplit.

fields.name: period_year
fields.description: Calendar year named by the source release.

fields.name: period_quarter
fields.description: Q1-Q4, Q1-Q2, or blank for an annual/partial-year source.

fields.name: period_precision
fields.description: quarter, multi_quarter, or year_or_partial_year.

fields.name: decision_status
fields.description: Catalogue decision list: positive or negative.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Language of the selected source; this build selects English.

fields.name: comparability_regime
fields.description: Scope regime for permanent-residence-only LMIAs.

fields.name: province_raw
fields.description: Literal province cell; blank where the source uses grouping.

fields.name: province
fields.description: Cleaned and forward-filled province or territory name.

fields.name: province_code
fields.description: Canadian postal abbreviation, or INT for outside Canada.

fields.name: program_stream_raw
fields.description: Literal stream cell; blank where the source uses grouping.

fields.name: program_stream
fields.description: Cleaned and forward-filled program stream when supplied.

fields.name: employer_raw
fields.description: Literal employer cell.

fields.name: employer
fields.description: Unicode- and whitespace-cleaned employer label.

fields.name: employer_key
fields.description: Case- and punctuation-folded employer search key; not entity resolution.

fields.name: address_raw
fields.description: Literal address cell.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Unicode- and whitespace-cleaned address, forward-filled when grouped.

fields.name: postal_code
fields.description: Canadian postal code parsed from the address when present.

fields.name: occupation_raw
fields.description: Literal occupation cell.

fields.name: noc_version
fields.description: NOC version inferred from code width and source year.

fields.name: noc_code
fields.description: Four- or five-digit NOC code parsed from the occupation label.

fields.name: occupation_title
fields.description: Occupation title with the parsed NOC prefix removed.

fields.name: occupation_label
fields.description: Canonical NOC code and occupation title display label.

fields.name: incorporate_status_raw
fields.description: Literal incorporate-status cell when supplied.

fields.name: incorporate_status
fields.description: Cleaned incorporate status when supplied.

fields.name: lmia_measure
fields.description: Semantic label for lmia_count; blank when the source has no LMIA count.

fields.name: lmia_count
fields.description: LMIA count when the source supplies it; blank before 2021 Q4.

fields.name: position_measure
fields.description: Semantic label for position_count.

fields.name: position_count
fields.description: Published position count, including preserved zeroes.

fields.name: source_dataset_id
fields.description: Open Government dataset UUID.

fields.name: source_resource_id
fields.description: Open Government distribution/resource UUID.

fields.name: source_resource_url
fields.description: Human-facing Open Government resource page.

fields.name: source_download_url
fields.description: Selected source download URL; recovered sources use the ESDC URL.

fields.name: source_final_url
fields.description: Final URL after the archived download redirect, without query strings.

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: Government source filename retained as evidence, not identity.

fields.name: source_format
fields.description: Format detected from the selected file content.

fields.name: source_catalogue_format
fields.description: Format declared by the Open Government catalogue.

fields.name: source_sheet
fields.description: Selected workbook sheet, or CSV for a text source.

fields.name: source_row
fields.description: One-based row number in the selected source sheet or CSV.

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 checksum of the exact selected source file.

fields.name: source_schema_signature
fields.description: Stable signature of the normalized source headers.

fields.name: source_disposition
fields.description: normalized or recovered_official_alternate.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: Pipe-delimited row/source caveats carried into the canonical table.

fields.name: normalizer_version
fields.description: Version of this canonical normalization contract.

measure_semantics.approved_lmias: Counts from positive-decision lists where published.
measure_semantics.requested_lmias_on_negative_decisions: Requested LMIA counts attached to negative-decision list rows where published.
measure_semantics.approved_positions: Approved positions on positive-decision list rows.
measure_semantics.requested_positions_on_negative_decision: Requested positions attached to negative-decision list rows.

important_limit: Employer-list rows are not application-level observations. The table must not be used to calculate an LMIA application approval or denial rate.
